title: timing / lap.recorded (v1) data payload
description: A valid crossing of the start-finish line. Published to the 'timing.events' exchange with routing key 'lap.recorded'.

masterId.description: Canonical masterId issued by Identity. Lowercase canonical UUID v4 (version nibble 4, variant nibble [89ab]); the pattern is enforced (format is annotation-only).

lapNumber.description: 1-based; the out-lap (first crossing) is not counted.

lapTimeMs.description: Milliseconds since the previous valid crossing.

at.description: When the crossing happened. RFC3339 UTC, exactly 3-digit milliseconds, literal 'Z' (AR9). The pattern is enforced (format is annotation-only).

transponderId.description: Hardware id if detected via transponder rather than QR. Optional.
